title: assign_thread loads ALL emails for every Email/set create — O(n) at scale
description: email.rs:652-682 — assign_thread calls backend.get_objects::<Email>(account_id, None, None) which fetches every email in the account, deserializes each one, and scans message_id fields. Called once per email creation. At 10k emails and 100 simultaneous creates this is 1M object deserializations. Backend needs a message-id index or the handler needs to accept a pre-built map.
notes: Would require a new backend API e.g. find_thread_by_message_id(). Acceptable for current scope (MemoryBackend with small datasets).
